run_lightglue_keypoint_matching: run LightGlueForKeypointMatching to match keypoints between pairs of images given pixel values
create_lightglue_model: create a LightGlueForKeypointMatching model from a LightGlueConfig for keypoint detection and matching
test_get_matches_from_scores: test get_matches_from_scores to extract mutual matches and matching scores from a score matrix
summarize_sigmoid_log_double_softmax: summarize sigmoid_log_double_softmax to compute log assignment matrix from similarity and matchability logits
review_normalize_keypoints: review normalize_keypoints to normalize keypoint coordinates based on image height and width
